verdict.rationale: dlt's docs explicitly describe automatic schema inference plus 'schema and data contracts' as part of automated pipeline maintenance, letting engineers adapt to upstream changes 'without losing velocity' rather than have loads silently break, and this is a first-party documented feature (schema-evolution page, contracts mention).
